notes: Urwa asked the man («فساءلته») and the man is named in Aisha's words («إن ابن عمرو قد قدم»). By rule 5 the one asked is a link, so ابن عمرو is the last link; the identity is the text's own naming and is not completed.
Aisha's words («يا ابن أختي»، «أحدثك أنه سمع») are the scene and her verdict, not a link.
The second meeting («حتى إذا كان قابل») repeats the same saying from the same man, so it is not a second route.
